what: A round badge wrapped in a text ring (text wound around a circle) — the ring keeps turning straight, one reverse turn (−360°) every 8 seconds. On interaction the center picture (a cut-out photo like a car) shrinks to 0 in .6s around its bottom center (curve .4,.4,0,1), and the small icon below (32px) floats up 43px in .4s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) while growing to 112px to take its place. On release both return in .3s (Studio background transition) — a Contact badge floating in a screen corner

options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Rotating text ring (svg — text wrapped around a circle with textPath)
options.[data-fx-part=body]: Center group (child that stacks the picture + icon vertically)
options.[data-fx-part=figure]: Center image that shrinks to 0 on hover
options.[data-fx-part=icon]: Icon that floats up and grows on hover
options.--fx-size: Badge diameter (via style), default 200px — 120px on phone
options.--fx-turn: Length of one loop (via style), default 8s
options.--fx-dir: reverse spins clockwise (via style), default normal = Reversed
options.--fx-icon: Icon starting width (set via style), default 32px
options.--fx-grow: Enlarged icon width (via style), default 112px — 67px on phone
options.--fx-rise: Distance the icon floats up (via style), default 43px — hero badge 48px · phone 28px
options.--fx-shrink: Length the image shrinks by (via style), default .6s
options.--fx-pop: Icon rise duration (set via style), default .4s
options.--fx-out: Duration when the hover is released (via style), default .3s

from.where: shared.css .r-badge (floating chat badge · Hero badge — original #bnr-txt kaiten 8s · on :hover scale(0) .6s · icon translate(0,-43px) 112px .4s)
